chapters.text: Start with a small sample. Independent samples: 5; Observed mean: 0.273; 95% normal margin (known σ=2): 1.75.
Add independent runs. Independent samples: 14; Observed mean: 0.454; 95% normal margin (known σ=2): 1.05.
Recompute the mean. Independent samples: 23; Observed mean: 0.937; 95% normal margin (known σ=2): 0.817.
Shrink the confidence interval. Independent samples: 31; Observed mean: 1.02; 95% normal margin (known σ=2): 0.704.
Distinguish uncertainty from performance. Independent samples: 40; Observed mean: 0.726; 95% normal margin (known σ=2): 0.62.
